messages.author: 392df9d6910eb20b
messages.subject: Getting error while deploying shiny app using shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi,
 a shiny app which works fine on local system where as  when I am trying to deploy it using shinyapp.io them I am getting an error which state that path should  to be  files
with in project  directory.



jcc = JDBC("com.ibm.db2.jcc.DB2Driver","/home/rspl-manish/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.4/db2jcc4.jar")
conn = dbConnect(jcc,"jdbc:db2://awh-yp-small03.services.dal.bluemix.net:50000/BLUDB",user="username ",
                 password="password")
Result<-dbGetQuery(conn,'select sale_date,count(tri_id) as Bill from retail_str_sales_master group by sale_date;')
Result$SALE_DATE<-as.Date(Result$SALE_DATE)



shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  
  output$linePlot <- renderPlot({
    
    # generate bins based on input$bins from ui.R
    x    <- Result[, 1]
    bins <- seq(min(x), max(x), length.out = input$bins + 1)
    
    # draw the line Graph with the specified number of bins using Sale date and Total no Of Bills
    ggplot(Result,aes(x=SALE_DATE,y=BILL))+geom_line()+scale_x_date(date_breaks ="5 day",date_labels=("%m-%d-%y"))+
      scale_y_continuous(breaks =seq (0,1500,200))+ylab("Total No Of Bills")+xlab("sale date")+theme_bw()+
      theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90))+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = 0.5,hjust = 0.5))
    
    
  })
  
})
